portfolio_v3.market_rationale: Stagflationary backdrop: Q2 GDP 1.5%, CPI 3.4% and PCE 3.7% with energy up 14.7% y/y, ISM prices indexes above 70, ten-year yield near 4.8%, Fed on hold with three hawkish dissents, and Brent near $99 after Houthi attacks on Saudi facilities. Breadth is weak (positive asset share 21s 37.7%, RSP lagging SPY) and SPY is near its 52-week high, so the index is exposed to the September 11 CPI and September 15-16 FOMC. Cross-sectional dispersion is wide, dominated by energy/commodity strength versus rate- and consumer-sensitive weakness; prior strong trends (semis, cyber, Taiwan) are pausing rather than clearly reversing.
